assets.name: hero
assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create polished editorial artwork for a hotel management website. Day of the Tentacle 1993 adventure game style: wonky playful architectural perspective, confident hand inked curved contours, clever cartoon prop design, flat cel color, detailed but beautifully composed. NOT 3D render, NOT generic corporate vector, no text, no letters, no watermark. Strict palette ONLY white, light tints of cyan #2ABDFF, pink #FF37C7, mint #00C3A0, violet #8251FB, with sparse thin charcoal #131313 outlines. Bright daylight, very light backgrounds, no dark areas, no yellow/brown/beige. Very wide landscape 3:2 composition for full bleed hero background. Dreamlike whimsical boutique hotel campus: asymmetrical white and pink hotel with arched windows occupies RIGHT third, curvy mint topiary and tiny travelling guests with suitcases on lower foreground, curved cyan pool at bottom, distant lilac buildings at far left. Top and LEFT middle 55 percent is almost empty pale pink sky with only a few wispy white clouds, deliberately clear for large black website headline. No lettering anywhere.
